items.title: Therapeutic Approach to the Hypotensive Patient
highYieldSummary: Confirm the blood-pressure signal while assessing perfusion, mental status, skin findings, urine output, and the trajectory of illness.
Classify likely mechanisms—hypovolemic, distributive, cardiogenic, or obstructive—without delaying treatment of immediately reversible threats.
Use repeated examination and targeted bedside tests to guide fluids, vasoactive support, source control, and escalation.
Reassess response and harm risk after each intervention; hypotension with shock physiology requires timely senior involvement.
examPearls: Shock is a clinical syndrome, not a blood-pressure number.
examTraps: Do not give repeated empiric fluid boluses without reassessing response and overload risk.
items.arabicExplanation: الصدمة لا تُعرّف برقم الضغط فقط. قيّم التروية والوعي والجلد والبول، حدّد الآلية المحتملة، ثم أعد التقييم بعد كل تدخل مع تجنب السوائل العشوائية.

items.title: Anaphylaxis, Acute Allergic Reactions, and Angioedema
highYieldSummary: Recognize anaphylaxis from acute airway, breathing, or circulatory compromise with or without skin findings.
Prioritize immediate treatment and airway planning; supportive therapies are adjuncts and must not delay first-line management.
Observe for recurrence according to severity, treatment response, comorbidity, and local protocol.
Document the suspected trigger, treatment, discharge education, and follow-up or referral plan.
examPearls: Absence of rash does not exclude anaphylaxis.
examTraps: Do not wait for laboratory confirmation before treating a compatible, unstable presentation.
items.arabicExplanation: التأق قد يحدث دون طفح جلدي. الأولوية لمجرى الهواء والتنفس والدوران والعلاج الفوري، ثم المراقبة والتعليم وتوثيق العامل المحفز.

items.title: Spontaneous and Iatrogenic Pneumothorax
highYieldSummary: Suspect pneumothorax from sudden respiratory or pleuritic symptoms and integrate examination, physiology, and imaging.
Treat suspected tension physiology immediately when unstable; diagnostic imaging must not delay life-saving decompression.
Select observation, aspiration, tube drainage, or specialist management according to size, symptoms, physiology, cause, and local pathway.
Reassess respiratory status and confirm resolution or a safe follow-up plan before discharge.
examPearls: Tension pneumothorax is a physiologic diagnosis.
examTraps: Do not delay emergency treatment for a portable chest radiograph in a crashing patient.
items.arabicExplanation: الاسترواح الضاغط تشخيص سريري في المريض غير المستقر. عالج الخطر الفوري أولًا، ثم استخدم التصوير لتوجيه الخطة عند استقرار المريض.

items.title: Seizures and Status Epilepticus
highYieldSummary: Stabilize airway, breathing, circulation, glucose, temperature, and injury while determining whether seizure activity is ongoing.
Search for reversible precipitants and medication or toxicologic causes; obtain collateral history when possible.
Persistent or recurrent seizures without recovery require an escalation pathway and time-critical specialist support.
After control, reassess neurologic status, complications, disposition, and recurrence prevention.
examPearls: Time the seizure from the first observed abnormal movement.
examTraps: Do not assume ongoing unresponsiveness is postictal without reassessment for nonconvulsive activity or another cause.
items.arabicExplanation: ثبّت الوظائف الحيوية وافحص السكر ووقت النوبة. استمرار النوبات أو تكررها دون استعادة الوعي يحتاج مسار تصعيد سريع وتقييمًا للأسباب القابلة للعكس.

items.title: Resuscitation of Children and Neonates
highYieldSummary: Use a structured pediatric assessment with age-appropriate equipment, weight-based references, and early team role allocation.
Prioritize oxygenation, ventilation, perfusion, temperature, and glucose while looking for reversible causes.
Reassess frequently because pediatric deterioration can be rapid and clinical signs may be subtle.
Document weight, interventions, response, caregiver communication, and the handover plan.
examPearls: Preparation and equipment sizing prevent avoidable delays.
examTraps: Do not use adult assumptions for airway equipment, physiology, or medication calculations.
items.arabicExplanation: إنعاش الطفل يحتاج معدات ومراجع مناسبة للعمر والوزن، مع إعادة تقييم متكرر لأن التدهور قد يكون سريعًا. وثّق الوزن والاستجابة وخطة التسليم.
